card.name: The digit 4 as a fraction denominator
card.fires_on: The digit 4 right after a slash and a numerator such as 1 or 3, forming a quarter fraction. It appears in measurements like inches, teaspoons, cups, and ounces.

modes.label: Fraction before a unit
modes.description: The 4 in 3/4 or 1/4 is followed by a measure such as inch, tsp, cups, or lb.

modes.label: Fraction in other settings
modes.description: The 4 ends a fraction used for needle length, time signature, or dose.
